gifts.title: New Player Limited Costumes
gifts.body: Limited costumes not featured in the current pickup banners. Each costume is enhanced to +5 when claimed.

gifts.title: Prestige Skin Gift
gifts.body: Prestige skins not currently available on the cash purchase page.

gifts.title: Limited Avatar Accessories Gift
gifts.body: Avatar accessories originally obtained from seasonal events or external promotions. Default outfits and achievement rewards are excluded.

gifts.title: Prestige Avatar Outfit Gift
gifts.body: The avatar outfit linked to a prestige skin you own. Only outfit pieces you do not already own are granted when claimed.
